capabilities: Display virtual heading numbers in Live Preview and Reading View without changing Markdown
Write, remove, or renumber heading numbers with a preview and confirmation, including batch operations
Number Figure, Table, Equation, and Code captions with per-type counters and placement
Show numbered footnotes, endnotes, and same-file @[[...]] cross references
Provide a heading-and-caption outline plus a read-only 2D heading mind map
extras: Runs entirely locally with no networking or telemetry; requires Obsidian 1.12.7+ on desktop and Android, with iOS unverified; optional U+2060 source markers are experimental and disabled by default because invisible characters can affect interoperability.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to display heading, caption, or footnote numbers, and adding them manually means rewriting heading text and breaking links.

relations.evidence: DocWen Assistant can export through a separately installed local DocWen application on Windows/Linux desktop.

summary: Heading numbering plugin that shows virtual heading, caption, footnote, and endnote numbers without rewriting Markdown, and writes or renumbers only after a preview.
